scope: Static review of the supported status path; not distro binary equivalence
collector_design: PrivatePIDs=yes makes the one-shot collector PID 1 in a private PID namespace. The fixed bootc command retains root and CAP_SYS_ADMIN as required by the pinned status path, while /proc/1 and /proc/self identify the same isolated process. The collector does not receive CAP_SYS_PTRACE.
